Grit meaning ke saath endurance.
Courage measure hota hai jo aap karte.
Darte huye bhi karo.
Courage ek repeat hone wala choice hai.
Grit sthir hai.
Apni mission par kabhi na rukna.
Bas tab bol jab tumhare shabd chup rehne se behtar ho.
Khamoshi taqat hai.
Aag mein bhi shaant rehna himmat hai.
Kaam shabdon se zyada bolte hain, par utni baar nahi jitna bolna chahiye.
Himmat andhere kone roshan karti.
Fortitude endurance ke saath courage hai.
Chup rehna aisa dost hai jo kabhi dhokha nahi deta.
Har us anubhav se jo tum dar ka saamna karte ho, tumhe taakat, sahas aur atma-vishwas milta hai.
Strength jeet se nahi aati—struggles tumhari strength banate.
Grit kendra hai.
Duniya ko jeetne se pehle khud par vijay pao.
Mistakes se mat daro—koi mistakes nahi.
